title: Bay Area Science Festival Robot Zoo at UCSF
description1: Variable Velocity was one of the FTC teams featured at the Bay Area Science Festival's Robot Zoo, held at UCSF. We set up a team booth and a practice field with a DECODE goal so visitors could see a real competition robot in action.
description2: Kids took turns driving and playing with the robot alongside our team members, while others stopped by our table to learn about the team and FIRST Tech Challenge.
bullets: Featured team at the Bay Area Science Festival Robot Zoo
Set up a practice field with a DECODE goal for live demos
Let kids drive and interact with the robot
Shared our team story with festival visitors at our booth
